data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after one of your **DIRE AVENGERS** or **GUARDIANS** units is **destroyed** by an enemy unit.

**Target:** A **WAR WALKERS** unit of yours.

**Effect:** After that enemy unit finishes its attacks, the unit can shoot as though in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), but only at that enemy unit, and provided that enemy unit is an eligible target.

**Restrictions:** This Stratagem can be used only once per battle round.
